Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

Summary of what you shared:
- Primary driver: customer data residency and encryption controls for the new Acme Payments service.
- Expected Q3 traffic: ~500k requests/month, spikes during batch jobs.
- Security needs: dedicated VPC peering, SOC 2/ISO evidence, and option for on-prem/private control plane for regulated markets.

What I recommended on the call:
- Redwood Dedicated or Private deployment (VPC) to give you isolated capacity, VPC peering, and KMS integration.
- Run a short technical scoping session with our Solutions Engineer (David) to map topology and finalize the deployment worksheet.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical scoping call (30–45m) with David to confirm network details and expected throughput — suggested times: Wed 6/17 10am or Thu 6/18 2pm PT.
2) I attached the Redwood VPC worksheet to capture CIDRs, egress policies, and KMS details (redwood_vpc_worksheet.pdf).
3) If security/procurement want any artifacts, we can provide SOC2 report, network diagram, and a draft MSA/POC agreement.

If you can confirm which time works or propose another, I’ll get the invite out and loop in our Security lead if useful.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
